intro: Solm Hargrin is the rogue trainer stationed within Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. A pragmatic dwarf who values honor amongst thieves, he instructs novice dwarven and gnomish scoundrels in the art of subterfuge. He firmly believes that covert operatives will prove vital as geopolitical tensions simmer across Azeroth.

p: Tucked away in the dwarven stronghold of Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin watches the snowy passes of Coldridge Valley with a keen, calculating eye. While Ironforge relies heavily on the brute strength of its mountaineers and warriors, Hargrin understands that some threats require a quieter, sharper touch. He welcomes budding rogues of both dwarven and gnomish heritage, deciphering coded missives for them and drilling them in essential techniques like Eviscerate. Above all, Hargrin champions a creed of professional loyalty and honor among thieves, preparing his pupils for an increasingly volatile world where subtle knives often shape the fate of nations.
